pattern: Segmented quarter field in a labelled group with a button that opens a non-modal dialog popup (WAI-ARIA APG date picker dialog pattern, non-modal variant) containing a paged role=grid of quarters with a roving tabindex.

aria.value: Help text and visible error message ids
"true" only while an error message is shown
"Choose quarter", or "Change quarter, {value}" (for example "Change quarter, Q2 2026") when a value is set
polite (announces the year when the page changes)
"true" when the page reaches min/max or year 1/9999 (focus stays on the button)
Quarter, year, and months, for example "Q2 2026, April to June"
"true" on the selected quarter only (absent otherwise)
"date" on the current quarter (configured timezone or today option)
"true" for quarters outside min/max or rejected by isQuarterDisabled

keyboard.action: Enters one digit and advances to the next segment; 0 and 5-9 are invalid. Non-digits are removed.
Enters up to four digits and advances when full; fewer than four digits is incomplete.
Quarter increments or decrements with wrap (1-4); the year stops at 1 and 9999. An empty quarter starts at 1 (Up) or 4 (Down); an empty year starts at the current year.

keyboard.context: Caret at the segment edge, or text selected
keyboard.action: Previous or next segment in the visual order of the LTR-isolated segment run (not mirrored in RTL).
Opens the popup without changing the segment.
Moves through the segments, then the button.
Opens the popup (or closes it when open); focus moves to the selected quarter, else the current quarter, clamped to min/max.
Next / previous quarter (mirrored in RTL), crossing into the adjacent year.
Same quarter in the next / previous year (the grid has one row of four).
Q1 / Q4 of the shown year.
Same quarter in the next / previous year.

Picks the quarter unless it is disabled; with closeOnSelect (default) the popup closes and focus returns to the button, otherwise focus stays on the cell. Emits aui-change if the value or validity changed.
Shows the previous / next year; no-op while aria-disabled.
Closes the popup without changing the value; focus inside the popup returns to the button. Only the topmost overlay responds, so a surrounding Dialog stays open.
Moves between the previous and next year buttons and the focused quarter; focus leaving the popup (other than to the choose button) closes it.

focus: Each segment and the button are tab stops. Opening moves focus to one quarter cell (roving tabindex: exactly one cell has tabindex=0). Movement is clamped to min/max and years 1-9999; disabled quarters stay focusable. Picking with closeOnSelect, Escape, and closing through the button return focus to the button; focus is moved before the popup hides, so it never falls to the document body. A pointer press outside the popup and the button closes it. Moving focus between the segments, button, and popup does not mark the field touched.
notes: The label is a <label> associated through aria-labelledby because a group is not labelable; clicking the label focuses the first segment.
The required asterisk is aria-hidden; each segment carries the native required state.
Each cell's accessible name includes its months (for example "Q2 2026, April to June"), matching the visible month hint.
The segments remain the primary input; the grid is an alternative, and a typed quarter rejected by isQuarterDisabled gets a localized message so both paths agree.
The popup is non-modal: focus is not trapped and the rest of the page stays reachable.
knownCaveats: Screen-reader behavior (dialog announcement, page changes, cell states) has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
Segment arrow navigation follows visual order and is not mirrored in RTL, because segments render as an LTR run.
